_draft: DRAFT (16 Oct 2026, John OK'd the plan): the hidden campaign pages /campaigns/<key>. Not linked from the header, the footer or the sitemap (noindex). 11 or more items from one campaign page get 20% off the item prices; shipping stays full price. The server checks the items, the count and the end date (server/offers.js). All texts are drafts for John to check.

index.name: Offers
index.title: Telning offers: 20% off 11 or more items | Telning
index.description: Telning offers for Halloween, Christmas and New Year: Story Walls, tote bags, mugs, postcards and greeting cards. Choose 11 items or more for 20% off.
index.lead: Pick an offer, then choose 11 items or more on its page, in any mix. 20% comes off the price of every item. Everything is made for you after you order.

faq.a: Choose {min} items or more on this page, in any mix. Then {percent}% comes off the price of every item. Shipping stays the same. You see the discount on the payment page before you pay.
Each mug, tote bag and Story Wall is one item. A pack of 10 postcards or 10 greeting cards is also one item.

faq.q: Can I add a promo code too?
faq.a: No. The {percent}% offer cannot be used together with a promo code.

faq.q: Is the rest of my basket included?
faq.a: No. The checkout on this page pays only for the items you choose here. Anything already in your basket stays there for later.
Every item is made for you after you order, then sent. The summary shows the delivery dates for your region if you order today. We cannot promise a date.

faq.q: Why can my order come in more than one parcel?
faq.a: Story Walls, mugs, tote bags and cards are each made in their own workshop, so they can arrive in separate parcels. Shipping is counted per parcel.
Unused items can be returned within 14 days. If an item arrives damaged or wrong, we replace it.

sections.intro: Four Story Walls for ages 7 and up, with small shapes and many details. Big Days has pumpkin lanterns among every big day of the year. Paws & Claws has a puppy and a cat, owls and a fox among ferns and mushrooms. Round the Year has an autumn corner with rain, umbrellas and a kite. Star Hoppers has a big moon and shooting stars. A few shapes are painted to start; your child colours the rest.
Organic cotton tote bags with our Halloween cats and dogs. Each design comes in one colour: undyed or black.
White ceramic mugs, 330 ml, with our Halloween cats and dogs. Dishwasher and microwave safe.
Packs of 10 postcards, one design per pack. Delivered to Europe and the UK only.
Packs of 10 folded cards with envelopes, blank inside for your own words.

sections.intro: Four Story Walls for ages 7 and up, with small shapes and many details. Round the Year has a winter corner with a penguin and a snowman. Home & Hearts is a street of houses with neighbours at every door. A few shapes are painted to start; your child colours the rest.
